Name: Wishing Well - incl. EN FR PT-BR ZH JP
Author: nicoconot
Description:
Idea provided by [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1300]TistoAries on GitHub[/url], much thanks!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[i][font=Courier New]The water shimmers slightly. It almost feels magical. What would you like to do?[/font]


[/i]The regular farm well is an oft-forgotten building in Stardew Valley, not serving much purpose other than filling your watering can if you somehow made your farm far from a water source. This simple mod allows you to throw a coin(spend 1G) in it and hope for your wish to come true!

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size][b][size=1]
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Once per day, you can interact with a well on your farm and choose to spend 1G for a 20% chance at a +1 luck buff with a 7 minute duration. The buff stacks with other food and drink buffs you might have. Multiple wells do not allow for multiple chances at the buff; The first one you throw a coin in is the only one that will count that day.
[*]Translation support: English, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese(courtesy of user [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CNSCZJ?gameId=1303]CNSCZJ[/url]﻿) and Japanese(courtesy of user [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/97820348-medisons/]medisons[/url][/b]) included.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b][list]
By editing the config.json file in the mod folder, you can change the following settings:[*]DailyLuckChance: The chance of obtaining the luck buff when interacting with the well per day. 0.2(20%) by default.
[*]WishingWellCost: 1G by default, only integers allowed.
[*]LuckBuffAmount: +1 by default, only integers allowed.
[*]LuckBuffDurationInSeconds: 420 seconds(7 minutes) by default. Set this to 0 for a day-long buff, similar to those of certain late-game statues. Only integers allowed.
[/list]

[b][size=4]Known issues/annoying things[/size][/b]
Nothing! The mod is perfect <3[size=1]                   (probably not. kindly let me know about any issues you find!)[/size]

[b][size=4]Possible issues[/size][/b]

[list][*]This mod has been completely untested on multiplayer, however, I have included some checks that would probably make it work. If you're playing on Multiplayer, please let me know if any issues arise!
[/list]
[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]
Chinese translation kindly offered by user [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CNSCZJ?gameId=1303]CNSCZJ[/url].
Japanese translation kindly offered by user [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/97820348-medisons/]medisons[/url][/b].

[size=4][b]Issues or suggestions?[/b][/size][size=4] Please feel free to contact me here on Nexus!
